name: Rifan Setiadi
headline: I build mobile banking apps at BNI, and AI agent tooling for developers.
aboutLead: Most of my work lives in people's pockets: QRIS payments, SMS banking, a campus ride-hailing app. In the evenings I build tools that let AI agents help developers ship.
about: For four years I've shipped Flutter and Kotlin apps: QRIS payments and SMS banking for BNI, a campus ride-hailing app at Coolva, and university systems for Unila. Outside work I build DevKit Agent, an open-source pipeline that runs analyst, planner and programmer agents inside OpenCode.
